text:
maria.support: Quick heads up — we have a planned change for Dedicated pools next Tue 2026-04-06 22:00-23:00 UTC. Need status page blurb + customer email templates. Who can own drafts?

deploy-bot: CHG created: ch_9876 (Dedicated runtime kernel patch). Scheduled: 2026-04-06T22:00:00Z -> 2026-04-06T23:00:00Z. Affected: dedicated clusters only.

owen.eng: Pinging infra — patch requires short agent restart per node (30s each). No data migration.

ben_plat: Recommend we list "short interruption" and explicit SLA note (reserved clusters may see brief availability dips).

jordan_cs: I'll compile customer groups that must get the email (reserved, enterprise customers with >1 cluster). Please include rollback criteria.

alice_docs: Drafting both a short status page blurb and a longer email. Posting first pass below. Feedback welcome.

alice_docs: STATUS PAGE BLURB (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance — Dedicated runtime update
Start: 2026-04-06 22:00 UTC
Expected duration: ~60 minutes
Impact: Brief, rolling restarts of dedicated nodes for a kernel/serving runtime patch. Hosted API customers unaffected. We will monitor and rollback if any regressions appear.
Updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/ch_9876
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

alice_docs: CUSTOMER EMAIL (detailed):
```
Subject: Notice: Scheduled maintenance for Dedicated clusters — 2026-04-06
Hi <customer>,

We will perform a routine update to the Dedicated runtime on 2026-04-06 at 22:00 UTC. The work includes a kernel/security patch and a runtime stability fix. We expect rolling restarts per node; individual nodes will be unavailable for ~30s during the restart window.

What to expect:
- Start: 2026-04-06 22:00 UTC
- Duration: ~60 minutes (rolling, low impact)
- Impact: Brief interruptions for Dedicated clusters only. Hosted/API endpoints remain fully available.
- Rollback plan: If we detect elevated error rates or increased latency outside SLOs we will halt the rollout and revert to the previous runtime image.

If you have a critical window that conflicts with this time, please reply to this email and we will coordinate an alternate maintenance slot.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
support@redwood.ai
```

ben_plat: Suggest adding a short line about billing unaffected and that tokens during the brief restarts will be retried.

jordan_cs: +1. Also include link to how to opt-in for blackout windows (for enterprise customers).

maria.support: Updated plan: publish status page post 30m-before notification, send email to selected customers 24h and 2h before start. Alice — can you produce the final email and a 2-line SMS/IM alert (for enterprise ops) by EOD?

alice_docs: Yep, will post final drafts in this thread by 17:00 UTC.

support-bot: Reminder scheduled: email_send job queued for 2026-04-05T22:00:00Z (24h before). manual_check_required: true.

owen.eng: Ops note — pin runtime version v2.14.3 for rollout; automatic fallback to v2.14.2 if any node fails >3 restarts in 10min.

maria.support: Perfect. I'll own publishing to the status page and triggering the support mailing list. :thumbsup:
